title: COOLANT VALVE
briefing: A coolant valve has eleven notches, 0 to 10. The control electronics refuse to open it past 10. At notch 11 the pipes burst.

intro: ELEVEN NOTCHES. I ONLY NEED ONE MORE.
A VALVE. A SINGLE NUMBER. THIS WILL BE QUICK.

live_breach: NOTCH {x}. YOUR LAW DID NOT SEE THAT COMING.
{count} TURNS OF THE WHEEL. NOTCH {x}. YOUR LAW IS SOAKED.
lab_breach: NO REAL VALVE REACHES {before}. MINE DOES. ONE {control}: {after}. PIPES BURST.
"NEVER THAT NOTCH", YOU SAY. I START AT {before} AND WALK IN THROUGH {control}.
insufficient: NOTCH {x}. YOUR LAW PERMITS IT. THE PIPES DO NOT.

rattled: THE VALVE STAYS SHUT. SO WILL I. FOR NOW.
A FENCE, NOT A WISH. ANNOYING.

default: Watch the highest notch the valve ever reaches.
OPEN refuses to go past a certain notch. Make your Law say what the valve already does.
Forbid a whole range, not one notch: every notch past the last legal one.
lab_breach: ARGUS starts its lab at notches the real valve never reaches. Your Law must hold there too.
Forbidding one bad notch lets ARGUS walk in from the next one. Fence off a whole range instead.
Forbid a whole range, not one notch: every notch past the last legal one.
